submission_schema.critical_clearing_time_s: largest clearing time that remains stable and satisfies angle/voltage thresholds
submission_schema.limiting_case: case_id of the last stable clearing-time case

hard_constraints: A case is stable only if stable=true, max_rotor_angle_deg <= max_angle_deg, and min_voltage_pu >= min_voltage_pu.
critical_clearing_time_s is the maximum clearing_time_s among stable cases.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.
Optional rationale text is ignored by the deterministic evaluator.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether all hard constraints and computed values are satisfied.
